import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXR = 11;
    static final int MAXN = 1000;
    static final int MAXM = 100100;
    static final int INF = 1 << 29;

    static int[] ady = new int[2 * MAXM];
    static int[] flow = new int[2 * MAXM];
    static int[] capacity = new int[2 * MAXM];
    static int[] next_edge = new int[2 * MAXM];
    static int[] head = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] current = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] dist = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] queue_arr = new int[MAXN];
    static int edge_count, nodes_count, source, sink, enqueue_idx, dequeue_idx;

    static void initialize_maxflow(int node_count, int src, int dst) {
        nodes_count = node_count;
        source = src;
        sink = dst;
        edge_count = 2;
        for (int i = 0; i <= nodes_count; i++) {
            head[i] = 0;
        }
    }

    static void insert_edge(int u, int v, int c) {
        ady[edge_count] = v;
        flow[edge_count] = 0;
        capacity[edge_count] = c;
        next_edge[edge_count] = head[u];
        head[u] = edge_count++;
        ady[edge_count] = u;
        flow[edge_count] = 0;
        capacity[edge_count] = 0;
        next_edge[edge_count] = head[v];
        head[v] = edge_count++;
    }

    static boolean bfs_leveling() {
        for (int u = 0; u <= nodes_count; u++) {
            dist[u] = 0;
        }
        enqueue_idx = dequeue_idx = 0;
        queue_arr[enqueue_idx++] = source;
        dist[source] = 1;
        while (dequeue_idx < enqueue_idx && dist[sink] == 0) {
            int u = queue_arr[dequeue_idx++];
            for (int e = head[u]; e != 0; e = next_edge[e]) {
                int v = ady[e];
                if (dist[v] == 0 && flow[e] < capacity[e]) {
                    dist[v] = dist[u] + 1;
                    queue_arr[enqueue_idx++] = v;
                }
            }
        }
        return dist[sink] != 0;
    }

    static int dfs_flow(int u, int F) {
        if (u == sink) {
            return F;
        }
        for (int e = current[u], f = 0; e != 0; e = current[u] = next_edge[e]) {
            int v = ady[e];
            if (dist[u] < dist[v] && flow[e] < capacity[e] &&
                (f = dfs_flow(v, Math.min(F, capacity[e] - flow[e]))) != 0) {
                flow[e] += f;
                flow[e ^ 1] -= f;
                return f;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int compute_max_flow() {
        int total_flow = 0, delta_flow = 0;
        while (bfs_leveling()) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= nodes_count; i++) {
                current[i] = head[i];
            }
            while ((delta_flow = dfs_flow(source, INF)) != 0) {
                total_flow += delta_flow;
            }
        }
        return total_flow;
    }

    static int rows;
    static String[] grid1 = new String[MAXR];
    static String[] grid2 = new String[MAXR];

    static int[] dir_i = {0, 1, 0, -1};
    static int[] dir_j = {1, 0, -1, 0};

    static boolean in_bounds(int i, int j) {
        return (i >= 0 && j >= 0 && i < rows && j < rows && 
                grid1[i].charAt(j) != 'Y' && grid1[i].charAt(j) != 'Z');
    }

    static int[][][] distance_arr = new int[2][MAXR][MAXR];

    static class Pair {
        int first, second;
        Pair(int first, int second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }
    }

    static void multi_source_bfs(int si, int sj, int phase) {
        for (int k = 0; k < rows; k++) {
            for (int l = 0; l < rows; l++) {
                distance_arr[phase][k][l] = 0;
            }
        }

        distance_arr[phase][si][sj] = 1;
        Queue<Pair> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(new Pair(si, sj));
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int ci = q.peek().first;
            int cj = q.poll().second;

            if (phase == 1 && (distance_arr[0][ci][cj] != 0 && 
                distance_arr[0][ci][cj] <= distance_arr[1][ci][cj])) {
                continue;
            }

            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int ni = ci + dir_i[k];
                int nj = cj + dir_j[k];

                if (in_bounds(ni, nj) && distance_arr[phase][ni][nj] == 0) {
                    distance_arr[phase][ni][nj] = distance_arr[phase][ci][cj] + 1;
                    q.offer(new Pair(ni, nj));
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int[][][] node_index = new int[2][MAXR][MAXR];

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        rows = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int T = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        int zi = 0, zj = 0;

        int node_count = 0, src = 0, dst = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < rows; i++) {
            grid1[i] = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < rows; j++) {
                if (grid1[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    zi = i;
                    zj = j;
                } else if (grid1[i].charAt(j) != 'Y') {
                    node_count++;
                    node_index[0][i][j] = node_count;
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < rows; i++) {
            grid2[i] = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < rows; j++) {
                if (grid2[i].charAt(j) != 'Y' && grid2[i].charAt(j) != 'Z') {
                    node_count++;
                    node_index[1][i][j] = node_count;
                }
            }
        }

        node_count++;
        src = 0;
        dst = node_count;

        initialize_maxflow(node_count, src, dst);

        for (int i = 0; i < rows; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < rows; j++) {
                if (grid1[i].charAt(j) != 'Z' && grid1[i].charAt(j) != 'Y') {
                    insert_edge(src, node_index[0][i][j], grid1[i].charAt(j) - '0');
                    insert_edge(node_index[1][i][j], dst, grid2[i].charAt(j) - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        multi_source_bfs(zi, zj, 0);

        for (int i = 0; i < rows; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < rows; j++) {
                if (grid1[i].charAt(j) > '0' && grid1[i].charAt(j) <= '9') {
                    multi_source_bfs(i, j, 1);
                    for (int ii = 0; ii < rows; ii++) {
                        for (int jj = 0; jj < rows; jj++) {
                            if (grid2[ii].charAt(jj) > '0' && grid2[ii].charAt(jj) <= '9') {
                                if (distance_arr[1][ii][jj] != 0 && 
                                    (distance_arr[0][ii][jj] == 0 || distance_arr[0][ii][jj] >= distance_arr[1][ii][jj]) &&
                                    distance_arr[1][ii][jj] - 1 <= T) {
                                    insert_edge(node_index[0][i][j], node_index[1][ii][jj], INF);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(compute_max_flow());
    }
}
